raw_segments.text: One piece of Pyotr Ilyich's evidence made a great impression on the prosecutor and the investigating magistrate.
Namely, his idea that Dmitri Fyodorovich would shoot himself before daybreak, that he had resolved to do so, had spoken of it to Ilyich,
had taken the pistols, loaded them before him, written a letter, put it in his pocket, etc. when Pyotr Ilyich,
though still unwilling to believe in it, threatened to tell someone so as to prevent the suicide,
You'll be too late, so they must make haste to Makro to find the criminal before he really did shoot himself.
